goal: Introduce a path-disjoint blindspot contract and Tech Lead planner, then converge shared indexes.

architecture_constraints.statement: SQLite owns durable observations and LanceDB is a rebuildable projection.
verification: deleting vectors does not change ledger admission

architecture_constraints.statement: A child branch must consume an explicit unmerged contract from its parent.

tasks.title: Implement the hybrid blindspot ledger contract
negative_controls: remove source readback and require exit 2

blindspot_queries.intent: Find every provider output that could bypass source readback.
blindspot_queries.negative_control: admit a provider row directly and require failure

tasks.evidence_boundary: Fixture PASS proves the checker contract only; live providers are NOT_EXERCISED.
tasks.cleanup_contract: Temporary SQLite files and reports are removed by the test trap.

tasks.title: Compile goal graphs into path-disjoint Worker packets
negative_controls: overlapping sibling path leases must fail

blindspot_queries.intent: Find shared mutable paths that make sibling execution unsafe.
blindspot_queries.negative_control: give two siblings the same path and require failure

tasks.evidence_boundary: Plan compile does not prove Git Town or a Worker ran.
tasks.cleanup_contract: Compiler output is written only to the explicit output directory.

tasks.title: Converge the admitted sibling contracts and central indexes
negative_controls: missing sibling receipt must block convergence

blindspot_queries.intent: Verify central indexes cover every admitted sibling artifact.
blindspot_queries.negative_control: remove one sibling link and require the index checker to fail

tasks.evidence_boundary: Convergence starts only after both sibling inputs have immutable admitted subjects.
tasks.cleanup_contract: No sibling branch or worktree is deleted by convergence.
